fair_value_policy: Fair Value V2.1 is the sole valuation baseline. Semantic scores must not directly overwrite official numeric macro series or Fair Value.

events.observed_evidence: Reuters imagery identified smoke rising from a fuel-storage depot at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh in the aftermath of Houthi strikes. Reuters also reported Saudi civil-defence danger alerts overnight in Riyadh and Al-Kharj followed by an all-clear; the precise extent of damage was not yet established in the reporting reviewed.
events.semantic_interpretation: This is a material geographic escalation because attacks are reaching critical aviation/fuel infrastructure around the Saudi capital while Hormuz and Red Sea routes are already impaired. It raises aviation-fuel, insurance, logistics and Saudi infrastructure-risk premia, but no unverified production-loss quantity is inferred.

events.observed_evidence: Interfax, citing the Russian Defence Ministry, reported Russian forces struck a Ukrainian cargo ship in the Black Sea and a tanker at a Ukrainian port. Reuters reported that it could not independently verify the battlefield claim.
events.semantic_interpretation: If sustained, direct targeting of commercial vessels reinforces the prior Joint War Committee expansion of the Black Sea high-risk zone and increases war-risk insurance, freight and commodity-logistics pressure. Confidence is reduced because the battlefield report was not independently verified by Reuters.

events.observed_evidence: Anduril founder Palmer Luckey told Reuters that the U.S. delay in approving a roughly $14 billion Taiwan arms package is affecting his company's business and that he has discussed the issue with President Trump. Reuters reported the package has remained held up following the May Trump-Xi summit.
events.semantic_interpretation: This does not itself indicate a new military incident, but it materially confirms persistence of U.S.-Taiwan defence-procurement uncertainty ahead of renewed U.S.-China leader-level talks. It can raise Taiwan geopolitical risk premia and uncertainty for defence supply chains without implying that the package has been cancelled.
